steps.surface: New session form → model picked → memory warning
steps.path: Round 5 of P-18 (round 4 was answered by screenshot in chat, not on its deck): the warning as a settings row
steps.headline: The warning is an expandable settings row: an amber sentence, a chevron that flips down to reveal the numbers and the toggle row.
steps.changed: No status dot, no strip, no Less button. It is the same expandable row every Settings screen uses: 'This model may not fit in available memory' with the right-hand chevron; open, the row's second line is '9.5 GB model + 15.6 GB for 128k context, with 8.9 GB already loaded.' and a normal toggle row sits below it. The picture shows it open.
steps.notice: Two rows that look like every other row in the form. Closed, it is one amber line.
steps.risk: Amber title text is the only warning signal; on Halftone and Meadow check it still reads as a warning against the theme.
